clusters.name: review-mail-overview-conformance
clusters.executionModeRationale: All stories mutate or depend on the single shared helper module lib/review-kind-summary.js (US-001 defines it; US-002/003/004 consume it) and US-005 stamps shared version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS/marketplace files. Parallel execution would guarantee merge conflicts on the helper and the release files. Run serially in one impl job with US-001 first.
